issues: The experimental baseline is specifically the homogenized Al0.7CoCrFeNi alloy; describing it broadly as conventional or as-cast variants is imprecise.

The boundary overstates dependence on exactly 6 GPa and 1473 K: 1473 K was optimal among tested conditions, but the paper says properties are tunable with pressure and temperature and presents HPHT as a broader strategy.
The reported ~1150 MPa is the engineering tensile/ultimate strength, not fracture strength; the true fracture stress is ~1570 MPa.
